title: Grammarly
short_description: Writing assistance and grammar support for NGOs and social purpose organisations.
long_description: Grammarly is an AI-powered writing assistant that helps users improve their writing by checking for grammar, spelling, punctuation, clarity, engagement, and delivery errors. It provides suggestions in real-time across various platforms.

title: Graphite
short_description: Developer platform focused on PR stacking, reviews, and workflow automation for engineering teams.
long_description: Graphite is an end‑to‑end developer platform designed to automate solutions such as pull request stacking and unified review workflows to simplify tasks such as creating and merging PRs, managing CI runs, handling notifications, and tracking development insights, all in one place.

title: GreytHR Academy
short_description: Online learning platform focused on HR and payroll upskilling.
long_description: GreytHR Academy is an online learning management platform by GreytHR designed to automate solutions such as HR and payroll upskilling and course delivery to simplify tasks such as course enrollment, progress tracking, certification issuance, and skills development, all in one place.

title: Grok AI
short_description: Conversational AI by xAI with real-time, somewhat edgy or witty answers, integrated with social feeds.
long_description: Grok AI is a conversational AI platform by xAI. It delivers real‑time, context‑aware dialogue across diverse topics, leveraging unfiltered and witty responses to engage users and integrate with social feeds.

title: Gupshup
short_description: Messaging infrastructure platform for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: Gupshup is a conversational messaging platform that enables organisations to build and deploy communication workflows across channels such as WhatsApp, SMS, and other messaging services.

title: Hive
short_description: Project management and collaboration tool with tasks, time tracking, and analytics.
long_description: Hive is a project management and collaboration platform designed to help teams plan, organize, and execute their work. It offers features like task management, resource planning, time tracking, and analytics to improve project efficiency.

title: Hootsuite
short_description: Dashboard to schedule, monitor, and analyze social media across channels.
long_description: Hootsuite is a social media management platform that allows users to manage multiple social media profiles from a single dashboard. It provides tools for scheduling posts, monitoring mentions, analyzing performance, and engaging with audiences.

title: Hotjar
short_description: User behaviour analytics tool for website and user experience
long_description:
Hotjar is a digital experience analytics tool (now part of Contentsquare) that helps organisations understand how users interact with their websites and applications. It provides visual insights into user behaviour through heatmaps, session recordings, and feedback tools.

It enables teams to move beyond quantitative metrics and understand user behaviour, friction points, and engagement patterns.

title: HubSpot
short_description: CRM and engagement platform for managing donor communication and outreach.
long_description: HubSpot provides tools for customer relationship management (CRM), marketing, sales, and communication, enabling organisations to manage contacts and engagement within a single system.

title: IBM Cloud
short_description: IBM's hybrid-cloud platform with compute plus Watson AI and other services.
long_description: IBM Cloud is a hybrid‑first cloud platform leveraging IBM’s global data centers and AI heritage. It offers a range of services including virtual servers, Kubernetes, AI/Watson, and blockchain tools.

title: Inkscape
short_description: Open-source vector graphics editor for illustrations and logos.
long_description: Inkscape is a free and open-source vector graphics editor. It is used to create and edit vector graphics such such as illustrations, diagrams, line arts, charts, logos, and complex paintings.

title: InsightOne
short_description: Platform to remotely manage, monitor, and update payment terminals.
long_description: InsightOne is a platform designed for the remote management, administration, and monitoring of payment terminal devices. It provides capabilities for real-time monitoring of device status, remote configuration changes, software updates, and application management for payment ecosystems.

title: Instagram
short_description: Visual-first social app for photos, Stories, Reels, and shopping.
long_description: Instagram is the photo‑ and video‑sharing social media module within the broader Meta communications ecosystem. It provides functionalities for feed and Stories posting, Reels creation and editing, direct messaging, influencer and branded content tools, shopping and commerce integrations, and audience insights within an integrated visual engagement platform.

title: Jasper
short_description: An AI content generation platform designed for teams to create long-form and marketing content.
long_description: Jasper is an AI writing assistant that helps users generate content for various purposes, including marketing copy, blog articles, and social media posts. It uses artificial intelligence to create human-like text quickly and efficiently.

title: Jira
short_description: Software project tracking for nonprofits
long_description: Jira is a widely used issue tracking and project management software, primarily developed for agile teams. It helps teams plan, track, and manage work and can be adapted for nonprofit organisations managing programmes, operations, and field activities.

title: Jitsi Meet
short_description: Open-source video conferencing with browser and mobile apps.
long_description: Jitsi Meet is a 100% open‑source video conferencing solution for web and mobile that requires no account and provides in‑transit encryption by default, with experimental end‑to‑end encryption for group calls. It offers features such as screen sharing, recording via Jibri integration, breakout rooms, and—on the free public instance—practical support for up to ~75 participants (larger meetings require self‑hosting or additional server capacity).

title: Joomla
short_description: Open-source CMS for websites and web apps.
long_description: Joomla is a free and open-source content management system (CMS) that enables users to build websites and online applications. It provides a framework for organizing and publishing content, with extensions for various functionalities.

title: Jotform
short_description: Simple forms for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: Jotform is a no-code form builder used by nonprofits and social purpose organisations to create digital forms for registrations, surveys, and basic data collection workflows. It enables teams to collect and organise data without technical expertise.

title: Journeys of Change
short_description: Learning journey and outcome tracking platform for nonprofits
long_description: Journeys of Change is a programme design platform that helps nonprofits structure fellowship and capacity-building programmes as learning journeys, track participant progression across milestones, and link activities to measurable outcomes.

title: KUDO
short_description: Virtual meeting platform with live language interpretation.
long_description: KUDO is a cloud-based platform that provides professional language interpretation and online meeting solutions. It allows for real-time interpretation during virtual meetings, breaking down language barriers for global communication.

title: Keka HR
short_description: HR, payroll, and workforce management system for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: Keka HR is a cloud-based Human Resource Management System (HRMS) that enables organisations to manage payroll, attendance, recruitment, performance, and employee records within a single platform. It is designed to automate the full employee lifecycle while supporting statutory compliance and workforce management at scale.

title: Kelsa
short_description: BPM platform for modeling, automating, and monitoring workflows.
long_description: Kelsa is a business‑process automation and BPM platform by Kesla designed to automate solutions such as process modelling and real‑time execution to simplify tasks such as workflow design, task automation, monitoring, and analytics reporting, all in one place.

title: KoboToolbox
short_description: Open-Source Field Data Collection & M&E Platform for Humanitarian and Development Organisations.
long_description: KoboToolbox is a free, open-source data collection platform developed by the Harvard Humanitarian Initiative, widely used by nonprofits, humanitarian agencies, governments, and researchers to collect field data, conduct surveys, and manage monitoring and evaluation (M&E) workflows — even in low-connectivity environments.

title: Later
short_description: Visual planner for scheduling and analyzing social content, especially Instagram/TikTok.
long_description: Later is a visual social media marketing platform that helps businesses plan, schedule, and publish content across various social media channels. It focuses on visual planning and analytics for Instagram, TikTok, and other platforms.

title: Looker Studio
short_description: Free web tool to build shareable dashboards from many data sources.
long_description: Looker Studio, previously known as Google Data Studio, is a free, web-based tool designed for data visualization and business intelligence. It empowers users to build interactive dashboards and reports by connecting to a wide array of data sources. Essentially, it takes complex data sets and transforms them into clear, easy-to-understand reports that can be readily shared.

title: Lovable AI
short_description: Lovable	AI-powered web development tool for building web apps from natural language descriptions.
long_description: A no‑/low‑code AI development platform aimed at enabling non‑technical users or product teams to quickly build internal tools or apps by leveraging natural‑language prompts and visual workflows

title: M-Files
short_description: Content and document management platform with metadata-based organization.
long_description: M-Files is an intelligent information management platform that organizes content based on what it is, rather than where it's stored. It provides features for document management, workflow automation, and information governance across various repositories.

title: Magento
short_description: Open-source-origin e-commerce platform for building online stores.
long_description: Magento is an open-source e-commerce platform that provides robust solutions for building and managing online stores. It offers extensive features for product management, marketing, sales, and analytics, suitable for businesses ranging from small to large enterprises. (Note: Magento is now part of Adobe Experience Cloud, not Deltek.)

title: Mailchimp
short_description: Email marketing and automation platform with templates and analytics.
long_description: Mailchimp is an email marketing and marketing automation platform that helps businesses manage and communicate with their audiences. It provides tools for creating email campaigns, building landing pages, managing contact lists, and analyzing marketing performance.

title: Make
short_description: Visual workflow builder for complex multi-app automations.
long_description: Make (formerly Integromat) is a visual platform that allows users to design, build, and automate workflows by connecting various apps and services. It enables complex integrations and data transfer between different online tools without coding.

title: MarketMuse
short_description: Content optimisation and planning support for NGOs and social purpose organisations.
long_description: MarketMuse is an AI-powered content intelligence platform that helps businesses plan, create, and optimize content strategies. It provides insights into content performance, identifies content gaps, and suggests topics to improve search visibility.

title: Medallia
short_description: Customer and employee experience platform for collecting feedback and analyzing sentiment.
long_description: Medallia is an experience management platform that helps organizations collect, analyze, and act on customer and employee feedback. It provides tools for surveys, sentiment analysis, and operational intelligence to improve customer and employee experiences.

title: Meritto
short_description: Student recruitment and enrolment platform for nonprofits & social purpose organisations
long_description: Meritto is an AI‑powered operating system for student recruitment and enrollment, offering modules like Enrollment Cloud, Education CRM, Application Platform, and Payment Cloud to streamline admissions and fee collection for educational institutions.

title: Meshy AI
short_description: AI-powered 3D model generation for NGOs and SPOs.
long_description: Meshy AI is an AI-powered platform that enables users to generate and edit 3D models from text or images, supporting visual content creation for communication, learning, and digital use.

title: Meta
short_description: High-level module for Meta's governance, R&D, and ecosystem integration.
long_description: Meta is the parent technology conglomerate module within the broader Meta platform. It provides functionalities for corporate governance, R&D investment in virtual and augmented reality (e.g., Reality Labs), developer partnerships, privacy and policy oversight, and ecosystem integration across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Oculus within a unified digital infrastructure.

title: Meta AI
short_description: Generative tools across Meta apps for content generation, image editing, and chat.
long_description: Meta’s generative AI tools across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp offering content generation, chat assistance, image editing, and productivity features.

title: Microsoft Azure
short_description: Microsoft's cloud platform for apps, data, AI, and infrastructure.
long_description: Microsoft Azure is a cloud computing platform that provides a range of services including computing, analytics, storage, and networking. It allows users to build, deploy, and manage applications and services through Microsoft-managed data centers.

title: Microsoft Excel
short_description: Spreadsheet tool for data management, analysis, and reporting
long_description:
Microsoft Excel is a spreadsheet application developed by Microsoft that enables organisations to organise, analyse, and manage data using tables, formulas, and visualisations.

It is widely used for data entry, calculations, reporting, and basic analytics, making it a foundational tool for programme and operational data management.
